Movie Night: Rio (2011)

2026-03-20 00:00:00 -0400

Rio (2011) is about species conservation, love, and… gazebos?

Rio follows Blu and Jewel, who are the last individuals of their specific species of parrot. They start out hating each other and, well, we’ve all seen this kind of movie before. They spend the movie running around the city, chased by exotic animal smugglers.
